Date: Sun, 26 May 2029 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: Helios MAP prep + technical dependencies (please review)

Team — quick internal note ahead of the workshop. Please review the attached draft and call out any blockers by EOD Mon. Key items to validate:

1) Data ingestion window: Helios plans to backfill 3 months of data by mid-June. We need an exact S3 ingest ETA and a tolerance for schema drift. Marissa: CS acceptance checklist should include a schema verification step and an ownership signoff.

2) Model variant & quantization plan: Ben, confirm whether we can start with the 8-bit quantized variant in staging to hit late-July target, or if we need an additional tuning sprint. If extra tuning is required, estimate +2 weeks.

3) Security/compliance evidence: Karthik, they requested KMS integration and an audit copy of our retention policy — can we prepare a short packet (SOC2 excerpts + retention summary) for the workshop?

4) Fallbacks & contingency: Ive suggested two fallbacks in the draft (regional failover + temporary rate-limiting proxy) — please add any operational caveats.

If were aligned, Ill propose Tue 10:00 PT to the Helios team and include the pre-reads.

Thanks — Soojin

Hi Alicia / James — confirmed for Tue 2029-05-28 10:00 PT (calendar invite sent). Quick alignment note and pre-work so the workshop is productive.

Workshop agenda (60 min):
- 10m: Introductions & success criteria (Helios)
- 15m: Delivery timeline + milestones (Redwood)
- 20m: Technical dependencies & acceptance tests
- 10m: Procurement and contract path (open items)
- 5m: Next steps and owners

Pre-reads attached: Helios_MAP_v1.xlsx (Responsibility timeline + contingency runbook) and SOW-draft-Helios.pdf (high level commercial terms; *draft*). Please note: the SOW is a draft; James, we will flag sections likely to change during the workshop. To keep PO timing intact, our ask is to resolve core SOW items within 5 business days of the workshop.

Key milestones (from the draft):
- Data ingest complete (staging): 2029-06-14 — owner: Helios Data Ops / Helios Onboarding (onboarding@helioshealth.com)
- Staging validation & acceptance tests: 2029-06-21 — owner: Marissa Cole (CS) + Helios Data Ops
- Pilot tuning & latency signoff (staging): 2029-07-05 — owner: Ben Carter (Infra)
- Contract signature & PO: target 2029-07-12 — owner: James Li (Procurement), Soojin Lee (Redwood Sales)
- Go-live window (soft launch): 2029-07-26 to 2029-07-30 — owner: Marissa Cole (CS) / Helios Ops

Contingency highlights:
- If data ingestion slips > 7 days: initiate temporary sample ingestion (top-20k rows) and extend pilot tuning window; escalation to Soojin and Alicia required.
- If security evidence (KMS/HSM) requires additional review: schedule a dedicated compliance sync and offer audit-excerpt package; this can add up to 10 business days to the timeline.

Immediate next steps (action owners):
- Soojin: Share final workshop invite and call link (Done).
- Marissa: Prepare the CS acceptance checklist and bring the staging test harness to the session.
- Ben: Bring an estimate for tuning time if we cannot start on the 8-bit variant immediately.
- James: Share procurement milestones and any non-negotiable invoice terms before the workshop.

Thanks all — looking forward to a productive workshop.

Best,
So-ji (Soojin) Lee
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
